thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-84723 fired: sustained 5xx spike on inference-gateway-usw2 (5xx rate 12% over 3m). Auto-escalation chain started. See alert: https://pd.example/PD-84723 :rotating_light:

oncall-sam: acked. taking ownership — starting triage.

maria: noted, seeing spikes from live-traffic path /v1/generate - adding logs to thread.

oncall-sam: quick check: region=usw2, cluster=ig-prod-02, recent deploy? no.

rene (dev): looking at proxy logs — upstream 502s from kv-cache-service. sample: `GET /api/… 502 0.23s server=kv-cache-02`

oncall-sam: ok, can we confirm if it's degradation or full outage? customer-facing impact?

jen (ops): cutting traffic to canary slice and routing ~30% to fallback pool per runbook. `kubectl patch svc routing -p '{"spec":...}'` done. monitoring.

maria: metrics: latency normal on fallback pool, overall error-rate dropped to 7% within 90s after reroute. visible customer errors still for sticky sessions.

oncall-sam: rolling restart kv-cache-02 and -03 to clear stuck connections. `ssh ops@kv-cache-02 sudo systemctl restart kv-proxy`

rene (dev): I see excessive keepalive timeouts between proxy and redis backend — bumping connection limit and enabling backoff config. Pushing small config: `proxy.max_keepalive=200`

incident-bot: PagerDuty note appended: acknowledged by oncall-sam. status: mitigation in progress.

oncall-sam: temporary mitigation held; continuing to watch for 15m. If stable, we will close PD and create follow-up postmortem.

jen (ops): customer-impact estimate: ~1.8% requests failed for 4m peak window; top affected customers on us-west 2. Notifying CS to prepare comms.

maria: logs show request payloads identical; suspect connection pooling bug introduced in kv-proxy 1.4.2. tagging release-ops.

rene (dev): agree. creating rollback PR for kv-proxy to 1.4.1 and will coordinate canary tomorrow if we need.

oncall-sam: thanks all. if error-rate <1% for 20m we'll resolve. leaving this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
